🌿 Verdis Eco Assistant

What is Verdis Chain?
Verdis is the world's first fully green, carbon-negative blockchain using Green DPoS consensus on Chain ID 909.
How does the explorer work?
Search by block height, transaction hash, or wallet address. Data updates live from the Verdis blockchain API.
What tokens are listed?
VRS (native), CARBON (carbon credits), ECO, TREE (reforestation), GREEN (validator rewards), and REDD (emissions reduction).
